home.badge: The youth wing of ISKCON Patna
home.title: ISKCON Youth Forum, Patna
home.subtitle: A community of students and young professionals in Patna practising bhakti-yoga — kirtan, Bhagavad Gita study, seva and festivals. Come as you are.
home.parent_strip: IYF Patna is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna, based at Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple, Buddha Marg.
home.pillars_subtitle: Four things we come back to every week.
home.pillar_kirtan_body: Weekly congregational chanting, a class, and prasadam together. No dress code and no fee — the first visit needs no registration.
home.pillar_gita_body: Structured study circles that read the Gita slowly and honestly, with room for the questions students actually have.
home.pillar_seva_body: Food distribution, festival service and temple seva — practice that happens with your hands, not only in theory.
home.pillar_yatra_body: Janmashtami, Kirtan Mela and pilgrimage journeys to the holy dhams, organised for youth and families together.
home.yatra_body: A devotional journey from Patna to Vrindavan Dham — darshan, kirtan and prasadam with the ISKCON Patna family. Youth and family registrations are handled on the yatra site.
home.about_body: ISKCON Youth Forum Patna is not a separate organisation. It is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna — the International Society for Krishna Consciousness — and operates from Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple on Buddha Marg. Everything we run, from weekly programs to yatras, happens under the temple's Management Council.
home.join_body: Bring a friend or come alone. No registration needed for a first visit — just turn up.
home.hero_image_alt: IYF Patna youth together on a yatra

about.title: The youth wing of ISKCON Patna
about.body: ISKCON Youth Forum Patna brings together students and young professionals from across the city for weekly kirtan, Bhagavad Gita study circles, seva projects and festivals. We are the youth wing of ISKCON Patna and everything we run happens from Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple on Buddha Marg, under the temple's Management Council.
about.parent_body: IYF Patna is not a separate organisation or society. It is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna — the International Society for Krishna Consciousness — and acts under the authority of the Temple Management Council.
about.council_subtitle: The ISKCON Patna Temple Management Council, under whose direction IYF Patna operates.
about.visit_body: The simplest way to know what we do is to turn up. Our weekly programs are open to everyone and need no registration for a first visit.

donate.title: Offer Your Seva
donate.subtitle: Every contribution, big or small, sustains daily worship at Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple, feeds thousands, and shares Vedic knowledge across Bihar. All donations to ISKCON Patna are eligible for 80G tax exemption.
donate.external_note: Opens ISKCON Patna's donation page in a new tab
donate.who_body: IYF Patna is the youth wing of ISKCON Patna, not a separate legal entity. It holds no bank account and no payment gateway of its own, so this website neither collects donations nor processes payments.
who_points: Your donation is received by ISKCON Patna — the registered public trust that runs Sri Sri Radha Banke Bihari Temple — through the temple's own donation page and payment gateway at iskconpatna.in.
Every payment is completed on that site. iyfpatna.in never asks for, sees or stores a card number, UPI ID or bank detail.
The receipt, the 80G certificate and any refund are issued by ISKCON Patna under the policies published on its site.
donate.seva_subtitle: Pick a seva, choose an amount, and complete your donation securely on ISKCON Patna's donation page. A receipt is emailed to you immediately.

how_steps.title: Choose a seva
how_steps.body: Pick the service you want to support and the amount you wish to offer.

how_steps.title: Pay securely
how_steps.body: You are taken to ISKCON Patna's donation page, where the payment is completed by UPI, card or netbanking on the temple's own gateway.

how_steps.title: Get your receipt
how_steps.body: A donation receipt is emailed to you immediately, at the address you enter while donating.

how_steps.title: Claim your 80G
how_steps.body: Form No. 10BE, the certificate used to claim the deduction, follows by 31st May of the next financial year.

donate.tax_body: ISKCON is registered under the {act} (Regn. No. {registration}) with PAN {pan} and 80G Unique Registration Number {urn}. A donation receipt is emailed for every contribution.
donate.form_body: The donation receipt is an acknowledgement. Form No. 10BE, the certificate used to claim the 80G deduction, is generally issued by 31st May of the following financial year to the PAN, email and WhatsApp number you provide.
donate.help_body: For cheque, cash, corpus donations or corporate CSR contributions, call the temple donation desk. For anything about IYF Patna itself, write to us.
donate.policies_body: The payment is completed on iskconpatna.in, so the temple's own documents apply to it.
donate.caution: Please be cautious of anyone soliciting donations in the name of IYF Patna through any channel other than the temple page linked here. If in doubt, call the temple before paying anything.
donate.final_body: You will be taken to ISKCON Patna's secure donation page to complete your contribution.
